description: This Perl module defines a class Git::SVN::Editor that extends SVN::Delta::Editor to implement a commit driver for git svn operations such as set-tree and dcommit. It manages differences between git trees and applies them to a Subversion repository, providing methods for creating, modifying, and deleting files and directories, as well as handling properties and text deltas.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Editor
classes.description: A class that extends SVN::Delta::Editor to facilitate applying diffs from git trees to a Subversion repository, handling file and directory operations, property settings, text deltas, and the overall commit process.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the editor, generating diffs between trees, setting up SVN commit editors, and configuring internal state.

methods.name: generate_diff
methods.description: Generates a diff between two git trees, producing a list of modifications with metadata, using svn commands and parsing their output.

methods.name: check_diff_paths
methods.description: Checks paths in the diff modifications to determine their SVN type (file, dir, absent).

methods.name: split_path
methods.description: Splits a path into directory and filename components.

methods.name: repo_path
methods.description: Converts a repository-relative path to an encoded file system path, considering pathname encoding.

methods.name: url_path
methods.description: Constructs a full URL for a given path based on the repository URL, escaping characters as needed.

methods.name: rmdirs
methods.description: Removes directories from the repository tree that are scheduled for deletion.

methods.name: open_or_add_dir
methods.description: Opens an existing directory in the repository or adds it if it doesn't exist, based on its SVN node type.

methods.name: ensure_path
methods.description: Ensures all directories in a given path exist, creating or opening as needed.

methods.name: glob2pat
methods.description: Converts a glob pattern to a corresponding regular expression for matching.

methods.name: check_autoprop
methods.description: Checks if a filename matches a pattern for auto-props, applying properties if matched.

methods.name: apply_autoprops
methods.description: Applies automatic properties based on svn config for a given file.

methods.name: check_attr
methods.description: Checks file attributes via svn command.

methods.name: apply_manualprops
methods.description: Applies manually set svn properties to a file based on svn attributes.

methods.name: A
methods.description: Handles addition of a new file or directory based on diff modifications.

methods.name: C
methods.description: Handles copy or move of a file within the repository.

methods.name: delete_entry
methods.description: Removes a file or directory from the repository.

methods.name: R
methods.description: Handles renaming or replacing a file.

methods.name: M
methods.description: Handles modification of a file.

methods.name: T
methods.description: Handles property toggling, such as symlink status.

methods.name: change_file_prop
methods.description: Sets a property on a file.

methods.name: change_dir_prop
methods.description: Sets a property on a directory.

methods.name: _chg_file_get_blob
methods.description: Retrieves a blob object for a file, possibly linking if special, and computes its md5.

methods.name: chg_file
methods.description: Updates file content with delta and sets executable properties if needed.

methods.name: D
methods.description: Deletes a file or directory.

methods.name: close_edit
methods.description: Finalizes the editing session, closing directories.

methods.name: abort_edit
methods.description: Aborts the current edit, discarding changes.

methods.name: DESTROY
methods.description: Destructor that cleans up resources.

methods.name: apply_diff
methods.description: Applies the generated diff modifications to the SVN repository by invoking the corresponding methods.
